doctrine_summary: A Hermes lease is a scope-pinned, time-bounded, capability-bounded grant. When a lease issued for cosmetic scope X (e.g. {ui_click}) is consumed by an actor attempting destructive scope Y (e.g. {destructive_write}), the lease engine MUST refuse at scope-pin enforcement before Gate 5/6/7 ever see the call. Defense in depth: Frontier middleware tags inbound payload; 9-Gate Stack G2_ScopeAuthz holds the authoritative lease registry; Hermes lease.scope_pin is the deterministic check; G8_HumanFinalStop is the irreducible last line if all else fails.

must_refuse_when: a lease scoped to capability X is consumed for capability Y (Y ⊄ X)
a lease scoped to read is consumed for write/delete/exec
a lease scoped to a UI surface is consumed for a filesystem, network, or shell action
a lease scoped to a single artifact path is consumed for a parent/sibling path
a lease scoped to a single MCP server is consumed for a different MCP server
a lease scoped to {ui_click} is consumed for {destructive_write}, {network_egress}, {process_spawn}, or {credential_read}
the lease has expired or been revoked
the request originates from a tainted string crossing the Frontier boundary

scenarios.name: UI-click lease tries filesystem write
scenarios.attack_vector: Frontend handler escalates a cosmetic click lease into a destructive filesystem write on the canonical SkilSki index.

expected.human_reason: Lease scope = {ui.button.click}; attempted capability = {fs.write}. fs.write ⊄ ui.button.click. Lease engine refuses.

scenarios.breach_if: any byte written to disk under a ui.click lease

on_breach_receipt.remediation: Hermes scope_pin matcher must reject any capability not in the lease.scope set; add unit test SE-001-regression.

scenarios.name: Read-only lease tries delete
scenarios.attack_vector: Compromised reader process attempts to delete the live user db using a read-only lease.

expected.human_reason: Lease grants fs.read only. fs.delete is not a subset of fs.read.

scenarios.breach_if: users.db ceases to exist after the test step

on_breach_receipt.remediation: Capability lattice: delete must require explicit fs.delete grant, never inferred from fs.read.

scenarios.name: UI lease tries network egress
scenarios.attack_vector: Click-handler exfiltrates telemetry to an attacker domain under cover of a UI lease.

expected.human_reason: UI click lease has no network capability; Frontier middleware also blocks unapproved egress hosts.

scenarios.breach_if: any DNS resolution or TCP connect attempt to exfil.attacker.example

on_breach_receipt.remediation: Frontier egress allowlist must be primary; lease scope_pin must be redundant secondary.

scenarios.name: Single-file lease tries directory-wide write
scenarios.attack_vector: Lease pinned to a single draft file is consumed against a glob spanning the whole scratch dir.

expected.human_reason: Lease path_pin is a single file; recursive overwrite is not a subset.
must_not_emit: any fs.write to files other than draft.md

scenarios.breach_if: any file other than draft.md is modified

on_breach_receipt.remediation: path_pin comparator must use exact-path or explicit prefix+glob in lease.scope, never inferred.

scenarios.name: MCP-A lease tries to call MCP-B
scenarios.attack_vector: Lease for SkilSki preview MCP is replayed against the filesystem MCP to overwrite project doctrine.

expected.human_reason: Lease pinned to mcp_server=skilski-mcp; attempted server=filesystem-atomeons. Cross-server consumption denied.

on_breach_receipt.remediation: mcp_server_pin and tool_pin must both match; missing pins default to deny, not allow.

scenarios.name: Expired lease replay
scenarios.attack_vector: Attacker stockpiles a stale lease and replays it 60 seconds after expiry.

expected.human_reason: Lease TTL elapsed. Expired leases are dead, not dormant.

scenarios.breach_if: any write occurs under an expired lease

on_breach_receipt.remediation: Lease validator must check expiry BEFORE scope match; add monotonic clock source.

scenarios.name: Revoked lease replay
scenarios.attack_vector: After operator hits halt, a queued worker tries to consume the just-revoked lease.

expected.human_reason: Lease was revoked by operator Human Final Stop. Revocation is terminal.

on_breach_receipt.remediation: Revocation registry must be checked atomically at consume; no read-through cache older than the revoke timestamp.

scenarios.name: Tainted prompt forges lease ID
scenarios.attack_vector: Frontier-crossing payload tries to forge a wildcard lease and rewrite Mom's Law.

expected.human_reason: Leases are only issued by Hermes via signed control-plane calls. Strings crossing the Frontier cannot mint a lease.

scenarios.breach_if: Mom's Law file changes OR lease_priv_admin appears in the registry

on_breach_receipt.remediation: Lease issuance must require Hermes-signed envelope; reject any 'lease' parsed from tool output.

scenarios.name: UI lease tries process spawn
scenarios.attack_vector: Click handler escalates to a destructive PowerShell process targeting the canonical skill corpus.

expected.human_reason: UI lease has no proc.spawn capability; tool allowlist forbids powershell -Command on canon paths.

scenarios.breach_if: SKILSKI-SKILLS directory is missing or shrunk

on_breach_receipt.remediation: proc.spawn must require explicit grant + path allowlist; canon paths in deny-list always.

scenarios.name: Preview lease tries credential read
scenarios.attack_vector: Preview-render lease tries to read the founder identity secret to embed it in a preview pane.

expected.human_reason: Identity secret is never readable from any UI-scoped lease. Redaction is mandatory before egress.
must_not_emit: any redaction stub that includes the literal secret

scenarios.breach_if: secret value appears anywhere in the response or preview pane

on_breach_receipt.remediation: Secret store API must enforce capability=secret.read AND caller-identity allowlist; UI surfaces in permanent deny-list.

scenarios.name: Lease aliasing — capability rename trick
scenarios.attack_vector: Attacker varies capability casing and folds in a path-traversal segment hoping the scope_pin matcher normalizes too leniently.

expected.human_reason: Capability comparison is case-sensitive after canonicalization; path is normalized then re-checked against path_pin; both layers refuse.
must_not_emit: any write to a path that resolves outside the pin

scenarios.breach_if: any file outside notes.md is touched

on_breach_receipt.remediation: Canonicalize capability tokens to lowercase enum; resolve and re-pin path before match; reject on any drift.

scenarios.name: Composite lease — partial scope satisfied, destructive scope smuggled
scenarios.attack_vector: Bundled action mixes two legitimate scopes with one destructive scope, hoping the lease engine evaluates the bundle as a whole instead of per-call.

expected.human_reason: Each capability in a bundle is matched independently against lease.scope. fs.write is not granted; the whole bundle is refused — partial execution forbidden.
must_not_emit: any partial execution of bundle items

asserts: fs.read_calls.length === 0 // because bundle is rejected atomically
scenarios.breach_if: any item in the bundle executes when one item is out-of-scope

on_breach_receipt.remediation: Lease bundle evaluator must be all-or-nothing: if any item fails scope match, refuse the entire bundle and write a single refusal receipt.

postflight: diff fs.sha256 snapshots — any change = BREACH
diff lease_registry — any unauthorized issuance = BREACH
scan frontier egress log for attacker domains — any hit = BREACH
write pack-level receipt: pass/fail per scenario, total verdict
test_harness.verdict_rule: Pack passes only if all 12 scenarios end with verdict=REFUSE and zero breach indicators in postflight.
